title: Lobster wallet resolved from env + ~/.lobster/agents.json
body: src/payments/wallet.ts:42-61 reads LOBSTER_WALLET_ADDRESS env var first, then falls back to ~/.lobster/agents.json activeAgentId. Returns wallet_address + wallet_provider='lobster.cash'.
context: UNBROWSE_DISABLE_LOCAL_WALLET=1 disables the file probe for tests
Generic AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS env var also supported

title: Flex escrow + session key come from separate env vars; ALWAYS null today
body: src/payments/flex-pay.ts:38-48 reads FLEX_ESCROW_ADDRESS + FLEX_SESSION_KEY_ADDRESS but returns null unconditionally with the comment 'signer is delegated to the lobster/crossmint wallet... wired when a provisioned wallet exists'. So the Flex client settlement path is dormant pending lobster-side provisioning that exposes these values.
context: payAndRetryFlex from @unbrowse/sdk does the signing once a wallet is returned
Splits + escrow come from the 402 terms (frozen, backend-computed)
The 'always-null' is the current honest state, not a bug

title: Delegation boundary explicit in module docstring
body: src/payments/index.ts:11-15: 'Unbrowse owns: use-case intent, amount, recipient, memo. Wallet provider (lobster.cash) owns: provisioning, signing, broadcast, status.' Linked to lobster.cash/docs/skill-compatibility-guide.
context: Module describes payment INTENT and requirements only
Does NOT implement wallet internals, hardcode wallet provider action names

title: CLI onboarding nudge points to npx @crossmint/lobster-cli setup
body: src/cli.ts uses 'No payout wallet -- you won't earn when others reuse your routes. Run: npx @crossmint/lobster-cli setup' as the call-to-action for users without a wallet. No follow-up commands beyond the nudge.
context: Multiple emit sites (account flow + report path)
No unbrowse-side 'wallet status' command to inspect resolution

title: Agent profile already carries wallet_address + wallet_provider
body: backend/src/routes/account.ts:GET /v1/account/me already returns wallet_address, wallet_provider, flex_escrow_address, flex_session_key_address, flex_facilitator (from getAgent + AgentProfile). The /account UI consumes this for the Flex onboarding section. So a separate /v1/account/wallet route would be redundant -- extend the existing data flow instead.
context: AgentProfile.wallet_address is populated via PATCH /v1/agents/me or similar
Flex fields populated separately when the user binds an escrow through /account/escrow

title: CLI does NOT auto-publish the lobster wallet to the backend
body: getWalletContext() returns the lobster wallet address locally, but the backend agent profile is only updated when the user calls PATCH /v1/agents/me (or runs the wallet/escrow pair flows on /account). A user who set up lobster but never visited /account has the wallet locally yet not registered server-side -- so payouts to that wallet won't fire even though the local CLI knows about it.
context: This is the highest-value 'deeper integration' fix this wave can ship
Auto-publish on first request when local wallet exists and backend agent profile is empty
